behavior_in_tests: The instruction explicitly requires the rejected CSV to have a '_rejection_reason' column, and requires the output CSV to have the same columns as input (record_id,name,amount,date,status). No test verifies the presence of the '_rejection_reason' column in rejected.csv, nor checks that the output CSV has the correct column schema.

deterministic_tests: Test T5 runs the pipeline on a 499999-row input with a hard subprocess timeout of 120 seconds. On a slow 1-CPU/2GB machine, a correct solution could exceed this wall-clock limit and fail without being wrong. This makes T5 non-deterministic with respect to hardware speed.

valid_failure_modes: The 120-second hard timeout in T5 (499999 rows, 1 CPU) could cause a genuinely correct solution to fail due to machine speed, not agent skill. This is an environment-dependent failure mode unrelated to the correctness of the fix.
